## Docs

- Published: 2025-08-06
- Modified: 2025-08-06
- URL: https://happydevs.net/docs/advanced-autocomplete-orders-for-woocommerce/getting-started/installation-activation/

To install the “Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce” Plugin go to your WordPress dashboard and from the Plugin’s menu click “Add Plugin”. n the search plugins text box write “Autocomplete Orders”. You will get in the search results “Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce”. Next click on “Install Now” to complete installation of the plugin. After installation is complete, click on “Activate”, in order to activate the plugin. After installation and activation, visit the settings page "Autocomplete Orders" from the WooCommerce menu. You need to ensure that the Autocomplete Order functionality is enabled by clicking the checkbox from the General Settings section of the “Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce”. It is enabled by default when the plugin is activated.

---

- Published: 2025-08-06
- Modified: 2025-08-06
- URL: https://happydevs.net/docs/advanced-autocomplete-orders-for-woocommerce/restrictions-free-version/order-types-restrictions/

To setup Order type restrictions, select the order types for which types of product you want to use Autocomplete Orders. You can choose from options including “All Orders”, “Order’s All Products Are Virtual”, “Order Has Any Virtual Product”, “Order Has Any Downloadable Products”, etc. Each of the above options have their unique usage. For example, if you choose “All Orders” then all of your products will be selected for Autocomplete Orders.   Likewise if you select “Order’s All Products Are Virtual”, only all the virtual products in your cart page will be selected for Autocomplete Orders.   If you choose “Order Has Any Virtual Product”, only the virtual product in a particular client order will be selected for Autocomplete Orders.   Lastly, if you choose “Order Has Any Downloadable Products” then only downloadable products will be selected for Autocomplete Orders. Click on “Save Changes” at the bottom of the Settings page of the plugin, to enable and use Autocomplete orders for your particular Order Types.

---

- Published: 2025-08-06
- Modified: 2025-08-06
- URL: https://happydevs.net/docs/advanced-autocomplete-orders-for-woocommerce/activate-license-pro/

To use “Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce Premium”, you must install and activate “Advanced Autocomplete Orders (Free Version)”. After activation of the “Free Version” plugin, install and activate the “Premium Version”. You need to “Activate License” of the plugin by clicking on “Active License” from the Plugin Page in the WordPress Dashboard. After clicking on “Activate License”, you will see a PopUp asking for your License key. Give your license key and click “Agree & Activate License”.

---

- Published: 2025-08-06
- Modified: 2025-08-06
- URL: https://happydevs.net/docs/advanced-autocomplete-orders-for-woocommerce/restrictions-free-version/payment-methods-restrictions/

You can set up Autocomplete Orders restrictions of different payment methods like “Direct Bank Transfers”, “Check Payments”, “Cash On Delivery”. To restrict Autocomplete Order based on Payment Methods. First, you need to select “Include” or “Exclude” for that particular payment method. Now select the particular payment methods for which you want to restrict or enable Autocomplete Orders functionality. After “Save Changes” you will see that your orders with/without Payment Methods like “Direct Bank Transfers”, “Check Payments”, “Cash On Delivery” will be automatically completed.

- Published: 2025-08-06
- Modified: 2025-08-06
- URL: https://happydevs.net/docs/advanced-autocomplete-orders-for-woocommerce/restrictions-free-version/product-restrictions/

You can set up Autocomplete Orders according to restrictions of different Products.   To restrict Autocomplete Order based on different Products. First, you need to select “Include” or “Exclude” for that particular Product. Now, you need to select the particular product by searching for the product name from the Products dropdown menu. After “Save Changes” you will see that orders with/without Products will be automatically completed.

First, you need to select “Include” or “Exclude” for those particular Product Categories. Then, select the particular product category by searching for the product category name from the Products categories dropdown menu. After “Save Changes” you will see that your orders with/without Product Categories will be automatically completed.

A conventional FAQ section has a straightforward layout with questions, solutions, and a dropdown menu. The main advantage of this feature is that customers can now access multiple FAQs and they don't need to scroll the page to view multiple FAQs at once. As a result, they can view multiple FAQs in a compact viewing area of the screen.   So let's learn how you can activate and make this feature in use.   How to Activate Multi-Column  Go to Happy WooCommerce FAQs Pro > Settings and then Enable Multi Column by clicking the button beside the option.   Now, Go to Happy FAQs > Add New, then create some FAQs & Answers, turn on the Global FAQs option, and then publish the FAQ.   Now go to the product page and click any product and go to the FAQs section to view all the FAQs.   As you can see, all the FAQs are available in multiple columns since the multi-column feature is turned on from the Happy WooCommerce FAQs Pro settings. There you go and that's all about the multi-column feature of Happy WooCommerce FAQs Pro. One of the most special feature of Happy WooCommerce FAQs is to manage FAQs from the product information tab. We know the value of your time. You can easily manage your product FAQs with these features in a very short time. The feature is a time saving friend for you. Quick Add FAQ In your product information tab you will find a tab called "FAQs". In the FAQs tab you will find a Quick Add button. When you will click the button a popup will come with a form. You just have to add a FAQ question in the question input and your answer in the answer editor. This answer editor is flexible. You can add any media file too to make your answer more attractive and standard. After all done, Simply click on submit. Your New FAQ will add to the product as well as an FAQ post in the FAQ post list. Remove All FAQs By clicking the button, All the FAQs will be removed from the product. This is also a time saver option. Reorder FAQ Items Reordering FAQ items feature makes your choice more flexible. You can reorder your items by simply drag and drop as your expected FAQ position. Select FAQ Post from the Dropdown FAQ Posts should be in the dropdown here. Simply you just have to click of the post title and the FAQ will add to the current product in last. Delete Single FAQ If you want to delete any single FAQ...

FAQ For Woocommerce provides you shortcode support. You may want to use any product FAQ list on any page on your website. Shortcode feature will help you. You just have to call the shortcode inside your content and it will bring the expected result to display the FAQ list. Following are the shortcodes and their uses instruction. Display all FAQs for a random product having FAQs with default template: Display all FAQs for a specific product: Display all FAQs for a specific product with a specific template by this Easy Accordion FAQ plugin: For Classic Template – 1For Whitish Template – 2For Trip Template – 3For Pop Template – 4
